subject: english-literature
title: Choose Your Genre
welcome_lead: Every story carries the DNA of its genre. Spot the signs.
meta_desc: KS3 English Literature adventure on main fiction genres.
final_note: You can now name and recognise five major fiction genres.

concepts.def: A type or category of story.
Future tech, space or other worlds.
A puzzle or crime to solve.
A story meant to scare or unsettle.

walkthroughs.body_html: Each genre has expected ingredients: dragons and magic in fantasy, spaceships in sci-fi, a sleuth in mystery, a couple in romance, a monster or ghost in horror.
Genre shapes what readers expect. Writers can meet expectations or break them on purpose for effect.
Many books mix genres — a sci-fi mystery or fantasy romance. Spotting the dominant genre helps you read with purpose.
